notes.title: RUM N' GOLD ROYALE - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Embark on a sea adventure in a battle royale genre!
In Rum N' Gold, you'll experience tactical battles, ship customization, and a dangerous storm.

- Naval battles – maneuver, fire cannons, and dodge enemy shots.
- Ship customization – choose and upgrade your ship.
- Storm on the horizon – avoid the storm and don't get trapped.
- Play with friends – find out who's the best captain!
- Gamepad support – play however you prefer.

Ahoy, captains! The open sea awaits you!

tags.feature: - Gamepad support – play however you prefer.

notes.title: Set Sail in Rum N' Gold on January 31!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains! Get ready to embark on thrilling naval adventures as Rum N' Gold Royale launches on January 31 at 10:00 AM UTC (2:00 AM PST).

This release brings exciting new features to enhance your seafaring battles:
[list]
[*] Fleet Mode: Challenge your friends by inviting them to join your fleet for intense deathmatch sea battles.
[*] Gamepad Support: Enjoy full gamepad compatibility and play the way you prefer.
[*] Achievements: Unlock and collect 29 achievements as you conquer the high seas!
[/list]
Prepare your ships, assemble your crew, and get ready to set the sea ablaze in just a couple of weeks. Adventure and glory await—see you on the open waters!
